take_homes: run 3-4 different checkers on the same output and score them against a labelled set instead of trusting one. they catch different things
every unchecked step multiplies error, so ten steps at 85% is about a 20% pass rate. put a detector between steps
a judge file that says what it can't catch is worth more than a broad one pretending to catch everything
